test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: DTGB is related to FVID in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, VRCK is related to XTEM. To which of the following is JAHM related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• DTGB is written as FVID

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4fc53c281a7df57220181f192bffee7a02d05035b59e6998c564d74f2eadbd9.png] 

And,

 
• VRCK is written as XTEM

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1fe9d958d41a53a367e4dcbc7f6a43fc1537eed8079898d01926b3018e22273.png] 

Similarly,

 
• JAHM is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4f7bc38462e8dce1b2e26f2f3d46c3e473554f32ee2c21e0458013dbc2f04f2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**LCJO**".
